name: Vietnam: business households and small companies

vatRates.note: The 8% rate applies to eligible goods and services until 31 December 2026; IT, telecoms, finance, banking, securities and real estate are excluded
The temporary 8% rate ends after 31 December 2026 unless extended again

dueNote: Business households above the exemption threshold declare and pay quarterly, by the last day of the month after the quarter, with an annual settlement.

presets.label: Business household, services: VAT 5% + personal income tax 2% of revenue

items.name: tncn
items.label: Personal income tax on revenue, 2% for services

notes: Households with revenue up to VND 500 million a year owe neither tax (2026 threshold); above it the rates apply to the whole revenue.

presets.label: Company: VAT 10% + corporate income tax reserve 20%
Company, eligible goods and services: temporary VAT 8% (until 31 Dec 2026) + corporate income tax reserve 20%

items.name: cit
items.label: Corporate income tax 20% (15% or 17% for small companies by revenue)

notes: When the temporary 8% rate ends, the reserve check reports the vault's rule as out of date and the app proposes the 10% rule with notice.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
